title: Raw restricted evaluation preserves the canonical higher-image class
statement:
Let $f:X\to S$ be any morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], let $F$ be an abelian sheaf on $X_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and let $q\in\mathbb N$. Use the common coefficient universe [def-weil-size-convention]. For $v:V\to S$ etale, put $X_V=X\times_SV$ and $j_V:X_V\to X$ [def-pc-base-change], and set $P(V)=H^q(X_{V,\mathrm{et}},j_V^{-1}F)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology, def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Let $A(V)=\operatorname{Hom}_{D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}})}((f^{-1}\mathbf Z[V])[0],F[0][q])$, with $\mathbf Z[V]$ the sheafified free abelian representable [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. Let $c_V:A(V)\to P(V)$ be exactly the evaluation morphism of [def-sbc-raw-restricted-cohomology-comparison-map], using the canonical identification of its derived-section target with this cohomology group. These $c_V$ form an isomorphism of abelian presheaves, where restriction on $A$ is precomposition by the free represented map and restriction on $P$ is etale cohomology pullback with the inverse-image composition identification [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. Let $\iota_V:P(V)\to (R^qf_*F)(V)$ be the canonical cocycle-to-cohomology-sheaf map in [sbc-lem-higher-direct-image-presheaf], and let $\kappa_V:A(V)\to(R^qf_*F)(V)$ be the canonical raw class map, namely the sheafification unit followed by the canonical comparison of [lem-sbc-abelian-higher-direct-image-natural-comparison]. Then for every $V$ and $z\in A(V)$,
$$\iota_V(c_V(z))=\kappa_V(z).$$
The assertion uses these constructed maps, and is natural in coefficient morphisms $F\to F'$. No affine, quasi-compact, separated, proper or torsion hypothesis is imposed.
